openCursor.models.default.markdownDescription: Model id for chat and the agent, e.g. `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5`. Empty picks the best available.

openCursor.models.inline.markdownDescription: Model id for Cmd+K inline edits. Empty picks a fast model.

openCursor.models.tab.markdownDescription: Model id for Tab completions. Fill-in-the-middle models work best: `mistral/codestral-latest`, `deepseek/deepseek-chat`, or a local `ollama/qwen2.5-coder:7b`. Empty picks one automatically.

openCursor.models.enabled.markdownDescription: Model ids shown in the picker. Empty shows every available model.

openCursor.models.custom.markdownDescription: Extra models. `provider` is one of anthropic, openai, google, openrouter, deepseek, xai, mistral, groq, ollama, lmstudio, custom.

model.description: Model id the provider's API expects.

baseUrl.description: Override the base URL for this model only.

openCursor.providers.ollama.numCtx.description: Context length requested from Ollama (num_ctx). Ollama's own default is very small; larger values use more memory. 0 leaves it to the server.

openCursor.providers.custom.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (vLLM, llama.cpp, LiteLLM, ...), e.g. `http://localhost:8000/v1`. Set a key with **OpenCursor: Set API Key** if it needs one.

openCursor.providers.openai.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Override the OpenAI base URL, for Azure OpenAI or a proxy. Empty uses `https://api.openai.com/v1`.
